lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately four distinct horizontal rows, with the most defined centroids located in the mid-flank region where pixel intensity is highest.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect the horizontal spot rows to form a coarse grid-like pattern, most visible in the central flank area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A continuous horizontal feature exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient (higher intensity on the dorsal edge, lower on the ventral) running along the upper third of the visible flank.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of smaller, high-luminance pixels is visible on the surface and leading edge of the pectoral fin.
